ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The Lorentz force demonstration instrument in physics classroom teaching consists of an excitation coil, a glass bulb, an electron gun, and other parts. The excitation coil is a pair of mutually parallel coaxial circular coils, which can produce a uniform magnetic field between the two coils. The glass bulb is filled with thin gas. The electron gun emits electrons under an accelerating voltage, and when the electron beam passes through the gas inside the bulb, it can show the trajectory of electron motion. If the electron gun emits electrons perpendicular to the direction of the magnetic field, after energizing the excitation coil, one can see that the trajectory of the electron beam is circular. If only the accelerating voltage of the electron gun or the current in the excitation coil is increased, which of the following statements is correct ( )
ready1_open_rewrite.title: The effect of accelerating voltage on the orbital radius
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In this Lorentz force demonstration apparatus, if the emission direction of the electron gun is always perpendicular to the magnetic field, and other conditions remain unchanged, when only the accelerating voltage of the electron gun is increased, how does the radius of the circular orbit of the electron beam change?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, it can be seen that the apparatus is composed of excitation coils, a glass bulb, and an electron gun; the circular trajectory of the electron beam is marked inside the glass bulb, accelerating voltage U is marked beside the electron gun, and the excitation coils are used to generate a magnetic field in the glass bulb region. This is consistent with the Lorentz force demonstration apparatus mentioned in the question stem. The condition in the question stem is that the emission direction of the electron gun is always perpendicular to the magnetic field, other conditions remain unchanged, and only the accelerating voltage of the electron gun is increased. Electrons are accelerated by the accelerating voltage, with eU = 1/2 mv^2, so when U increases, the electron speed v increases. After electrons enter the magnetic field perpendicularly, the Lorentz force provides the centripetal force: evB = mv^2/r, and rearranging gives r = mv/(eB). Since other conditions remain unchanged and the magnetic field B remains unchanged, when v increases, the circular orbital radius r increases.

method.method_draft: 从题干读取条件：电子枪发射方向始终垂直于磁场，其他条件不变，只增大电子枪加速电压；从图中确认这是电子枪在励磁线圈产生的磁场中形成圆形轨道的洛伦兹力演示仪。解题时先用加速电压决定电子速度：eU=1/2mv^2，因此U增大使v增大；再用垂直磁场中洛伦兹力提供向心力：evB=mv^2/r，得r=mv/(eB)。由于其他条件不变，B不变，所以v增大导致r增大。
